takes the top three bits of byte `rcx+3` (`shr 5`): when they equal 3 stores `xmm1` as float `+0xC8` of qword `rcx+0xB8` and sets byte `+0xDD` of that qword to 1 when `xmm1` is below 0.0 (`comiss`/`seta`, so 0 for NaN) else 0, when they equal 1 stores the float at `+0x68` and the flag at byte `+0x5C` instead, and for any other value stores nothing; every path then tail-jumps with the incoming `rcx` and `xmm1` (at `0026BA00` + 0x32 for 3, at `0026BA00` + 0x52 otherwise; both reach the same target)
